entries.name: Adamantine Armor
entries.description: Reinforced with adamantine: any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

properties.applies_to_keys: breastplate, chain-mail, chain-shirt, half-plate-armor, plate-armor, ring-mail, scale-mail, splint-armor

entries.name: Ammunition of Slaying
entries.description: Made to slay one creature type, chosen by the GM: a creature of that type it damages makes a DC 17 Constitution save or takes an extra 6d10 Force damage (half on a success). It then loses its magic.

entries.name: Ammunition +1
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls with this ammunition; it loses its magic once it hits.

entries.name: Ammunition +2
entries.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls with this ammunition; it loses its magic once it hits.

entries.name: Ammunition +3
entries.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls with this ammunition; it loses its magic once it hits.

entries.name: Amulet of Health
entries.description: Your Constitution is 19 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 19 or more).

entries.name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
entries.description: You can't be targeted by Divination spells or seen through magical scrying sensors unless you allow it.

entries.name: Amulet of the Planes
entries.description: As a Magic action, name a place on another plane and make a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check: on a success you cast Plane Shift, on a failure you and everything within 15 feet travel somewhere random.

entries.name: Animated Shield
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, it animates for 1 minute and protects you as if you held it, leaving your hands free.

entries.name: Apparatus of the Crab
entries.description: A 500-pound iron barrel that unfolds into a crab-like vehicle for two Medium creatures, steered with ten levers, able to walk, swim and grab with its pincers.

entries.name: Armor of Invulnerability
entries.description: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage. Once per dawn, a Magic action gives Immunity to them for 10 minutes.

entries.name: Armor of Resistance
entries.description: Resistance to one damage type, chosen by the GM or rolled (acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder).

entries.name: Armor of Vulnerability
entries.description: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage, but cursed: you are vulnerable to the two other types until the curse is lifted.

entries.name: Armor +1
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class while you wear it.

entries.name: Armor +2
entries.description: +2 to Armor Class while you wear it.

entries.name: Armor +3
entries.description: +3 to Armor Class while you wear it.

entries.name: Arrow-Catching Shield
entries.description: +2 to AC against ranged attacks, on top of the Shield. As a Reaction, you can become the target of a ranged attack aimed at a creature within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Bag of Beans
entries.description: Holds 3d4 beans. Dumped, they explode in a 10-foot Sphere (5d4 Fire damage, DC 15 Dexterity); planted, one grows into a random wonder chosen by the GM.

entries.name: Bag of Devouring
entries.description: Looks like a Bag of Holding but is the mouth of a creature: anything animal or vegetable put inside is devoured, and a creature reaching in may be pulled in.

entries.name: Bag of Holding
entries.description: Holds up to 500 pounds (64 cubic feet) yet always weighs 5 pounds. Taking an item out is a Utilize action.

entries.name: Bag of Tricks
entries.description: As a Magic action, pull out a fuzzy ball and throw it: it becomes a random creature that obeys you for 1 minute. Three uses per dawn.

entries.name: Bead of Force
entries.description: Thrown up to 60 feet, it explodes in a 10-foot Sphere: DC 15 Dexterity or 5d4 Force damage and trapped in a sphere of force for 1 minute.

entries.name: Bead of Nourishment
entries.description: Dissolves on your tongue and nourishes you as much as 1 day of Rations.

entries.name: Belt of Cloud Giant Strength
entries.description: Your Strength is 27 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 27 or more).

entries.name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
entries.description: You know Dwarvish, have Advantage on Persuasion with dwarves, your Constitution increases by 2 (to 20 at most), and you may grow a beard.

entries.name: Belt of Fire Giant Strength
entries.description: Your Strength is 25 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 25 or more).

entries.name: Belt of Frost Giant Strength
entries.description: Your Strength is 23 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 23 or more).

entries.name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
entries.description: Your Strength is 21 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 21 or more).

entries.name: Belt of Stone Giant Strength
entries.description: Your Strength is 23 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 23 or more).

entries.name: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
entries.description: Your Strength is 29 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 29 or more).

entries.name: Berserker Axe
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage, and +1 Hit Point maximum per level while attuned. Cursed: you can't part with it, and may fly into a rage when hurt.

entries.name: Boots of Elvenkind
entries.description: Your steps make no sound, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

entries.name: Boots of Levitation
entries.description: You can cast Levitate on yourself while wearing them.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, double your Speed and impose Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you, for up to 10 minutes per long rest.

entries.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
entries.description: Your Speed is at least 30 feet and isn't reduced by weight or Heavy Armor; once per turn you can jump 30 feet for 10 feet of movement.

entries.name: Boots of the Winterlands
entries.description: Resistance to Cold damage, comfort in extreme cold, and you ignore Difficult Terrain made of ice or snow.

entries.name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
entries.description: Filled with water, it summons a Water Elemental that obeys you for 1 hour. Once per dawn.

entries.name: Bracers of Archery
entries.description: Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows, and +2 to damage with them.

entries.name: Bracers of Defense
entries.description: +2 to Armor Class while you wear no armor and use no Shield.

entries.name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals
entries.description: Summons a Fire Elemental that obeys you for 1 hour. Once per dawn.

entries.name: Brooch of Shielding
entries.description: Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to the Magic Missile spell.

entries.name: Broom of Flying
entries.description: Ridden in the air with a Fly Speed of 50 feet (30 feet over 200 pounds); it can also fly alone to you.

entries.name: Candle of Invocation
entries.description: Lit, it helps creatures of its alignment (Advantage on d20 tests) for up to 4 hours, or lets you cast Gate once.

entries.name: Cape of the Mountebank
entries.description: Cast Dimension Door as a Magic action, leaving a cloud of smoke behind. Once per dawn.

entries.name: Carpet of Flying
entries.description: Flies at your command within 30 feet; its size sets how much it carries and how fast it flies.

entries.name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals
entries.description: Swung, it summons an Air Elemental that obeys you for 1 hour. Once per dawn.

entries.name: Chime of Opening
entries.description: Struck, it casts Knock, its ringing heard 300 feet away. Ten uses, then it cracks.

entries.name: Circlet of Blasting
entries.description: Cast Scorching Ray with it (+5 to hit). Once per dawn.

entries.name: Cloak of Arachnida
entries.description: Resistance to Poison damage, a Climb Speed, walk on webs, and cast Web once per dawn.

entries.name: Cloak of Displacement
entries.description: An illusion of your position gives Disadvantage to attacks against you, until you take damage (back at the start of your next turn).

entries.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
entries.description: Perception checks to notice you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

entries.name: Cloak of Invisibility
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend 1 to be Invisible for 1 hour with the hood pulled up.

entries.name: Cloak of Protection
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear it.

entries.name: Cloak of the Bat
entries.description: Advantage on Stealth; in Dim Light or Darkness you can fly at 40 feet, and once per dawn turn into a bat.

entries.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
entries.description: You breathe underwater and have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

entries.name: Crystal Ball
entries.description: Cast Scrying (DC 17) while touching it.

entries.name: Crystal Ball of Mind Reading
entries.description: Scrying (DC 17), and Detect Thoughts on creatures seen through the sensor.

entries.name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy
entries.description: Scrying (DC 17), telepathy with creatures seen through the sensor, and Suggestion on one of them once per dawn.

entries.name: Crystal Ball of True Seeing
entries.description: Scrying (DC 17), with Truesight of 120 feet around the sensor.

entries.name: Cube of Force
entries.description: 10 charges (back at dawn): press a face to cast a spell of force (save DC 17), from a barrier against gases to Resilient Sphere.

entries.name: Cubic Gate
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): each face is keyed to a plane; spend a charge to cast Gate or Plane Shift to that plane.

entries.name: Dagger of Venom
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage. As a Bonus Action, coat it with poison for 1 minute: the next creature hit makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 2d10 Poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute.

entries.name: Dancing Sword
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, toss it: it hovers, flies 30 feet and attacks using your attack roll, for up to four turns.

entries.name: Decanter of Endless Water
entries.description: As a Magic action, pours fresh or salt water: a stream, a fountain or a geyser that can knock a creature Prone.

entries.name: Deck of Illusions
entries.description: Draw a card at random and throw it: it becomes an illusion of a creature until dispelled.

entries.name: Defender
entries.description: +3 to attack and damage; on your turn you can move some of that bonus to your Armor Class until your next turn.

properties.applies_to_keys: battleaxe, club, dagger, dart, flail, glaive, greataxe, greatclub, greatsword, halberd, handaxe, javelin, lance, light-hammer, longsword, mace, maul, morningstar, pike, quarterstaff, rapier, scimitar, shortsword, sickle, spear, trident, war-pick, warhammer, whip

entries.name: Demon Armor
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class, you know Abyssal, and your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Slashing damage with +1 to attack and damage. Cursed: you can't take it off.

entries.name: Dimensional Shackles
entries.description: Put on an Incapacitated creature, they stop any extradimensional travel, teleportation included.

entries.name: Dragon Orb
entries.description: An artifact: peer into it (DC 15 Charisma) to control dragons nearby, and cast powerful spells from it; failing, it controls you.

entries.name: Dragon Scale Mail
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class, Advantage on saves against Dragon breath, Resistance to the damage of its dragon, and you can sense that kind of dragon once per dawn.

entries.name: Dragon Slayer
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage, and 3d6 extra damage against a Dragon.

entries.name: Dust of Disappearance
entries.description: One use: you and everything within 10 feet become Invisible for 2d4 minutes.

entries.name: Dust of Dryness
entries.description: 1d6 + 4 pinches: one turns a 15-foot Cube of water into a pellet, which releases it when broken.

entries.name: Dust of Sneezing and Choking
entries.description: Looks like Dust of Disappearance: thrown, everyone within 30 feet, you included, makes a DC 15 Constitution save or chokes and sneezes for 1 minute.

entries.name: Dwarven Plate
entries.description: +2 to Armor Class, and a Reaction to reduce by 10 feet a push along the ground.

entries.name: Dwarven Thrower
entries.description: +3 to attack and damage, it can be thrown (20/60 feet) and comes back to your hand, with 1d8 extra Force damage (2d8 against a Giant).

entries.name: Efficient Quiver
entries.description: Three extradimensional compartments: 60 arrows, 18 javelins, 6 bows or staves, and it never weighs more than 2 pounds.

entries.name: Efreeti Bottle
entries.description: Opened, it releases an Efreeti, who may serve you, grant wishes or attack, as rolled the first time.

entries.name: Elemental Gem
entries.description: Broken, it summons an elemental of its kind that obeys you for 1 hour.

entries.name: Elixir of Health
entries.description: Cures all magical contagions and ends the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed and Poisoned conditions.

entries.name: Elven Chain
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class, and you count as trained with it even without Medium or Heavy armor training.

entries.name: Energy Bow
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage; its arrows of golden energy deal Force damage, and it can make a ladder of light or restrain a target.

entries.name: Eversmoking Bottle
entries.description: Open, it fills an ever-growing area with thick smoke that Heavily Obscures it.

entries.name: Eyes of Charming
entries.description: 3 charges (back at dawn): cast Charm Person (DC 13), higher with more charges.

entries.name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
entries.description: Darkvision within 1 foot and Advantage on Investigation to examine something that close.

entries.name: Eyes of the Eagle
entries.description: Advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight, and you see details very far away.

entries.name: Feather Token
entries.description: Single use, its effect set by its kind: an anchor, a bird, a fan, a swan boat, a tree or a whip.

entries.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power
entries.description: Thrown, it becomes a living creature that obeys you for a time, then a statuette again until it recharges.

entries.name: Flame Tongue
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, flames engulf it: it sheds light and deals 2d6 extra Fire damage until you end it.

properties.applies_to_keys: battleaxe, club, dagger, dart, flail, glaive, greataxe, greatclub, greatsword, halberd, handaxe, javelin, lance, light-hammer, longsword, mace, maul, morningstar, pike, quarterstaff, rapier, scimitar, shortsword, sickle, spear, trident, war-pick, warhammer, whip

entries.name: Folding Boat
entries.description: A 4-pound box that unfolds into a rowboat or a ship, and folds back, on command words.

entries.name: Frost Brand
entries.description: 1d6 extra Cold damage, Resistance to Fire damage, light in freezing cold, and it can put out fires nearby.

properties.applies_to_keys: glaive, greatsword, longsword, rapier, scimitar, shortsword

entries.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
entries.description: Your Strength is 19 while you wear them (no effect if it is already 19 or more).

entries.name: Gem of Brightness
entries.description: 50 charges: light, a blinding ray at one creature, or a flash that can blind everyone around.

entries.name: Gem of Seeing
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): 1 charge gives Truesight of 120 feet for 10 minutes through the gem.

entries.name: Giant Slayer
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage; a Giant hit takes 2d6 extra damage and makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone.

entries.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class, and as a Bonus Action it looks like ordinary clothes or another armor.

entries.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
entries.description: As a Reaction, reduce the damage of a ranged or thrown weapon by 1d10 + Dexterity, and catch it if reduced to 0.

entries.name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
entries.description: A Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and +5 to Athletics to climb or swim.

entries.name: Gloves of Thievery
entries.description: Invisible while worn, and +5 to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.

entries.name: Goggles of Night
entries.description: Darkvision of 60 feet, or 60 feet more if you already have it.

entries.name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage, 5 charges to hurl it as a thunderbolt, and with the matching gauntlets and belt it can slay giants.

entries.name: Handy Haversack
entries.description: Two side pouches of 200 pounds and a central pouch of 500 pounds, yet it weighs 5 pounds; what you want is always on top.

entries.name: Hat of Disguise
entries.description: Cast Disguise Self while wearing it.

entries.name: Hat of Many Spells
entries.description: A Spellcasting Focus for Wizard spells; you can try to pull an unknown spell out of it, with an unpredictable result.

entries.name: Headband of Intellect
entries.description: Your Intelligence is 19 while you wear it (no effect if it is already 19 or more).

entries.name: Helm of Brilliance
entries.description: Set with gems that cast light and fire spells, sheds light, burns undead and protects against fire.

entries.name: Helm of Comprehending Languages
entries.description: Cast Comprehend Languages from it.

entries.name: Helm of Telepathy
entries.description: Telepathy within 30 feet, and Detect Thoughts or Suggestion (DC 13) once each per dawn.

entries.name: Helm of Teleportation
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): 1 charge to cast Teleport.

entries.name: Holy Avenger
entries.description: +3 to attack and damage, 2d10 extra Radiant damage against Fiends and Undead, and an aura of 10 feet giving Advantage on saves against spells. Attunement by a Paladin.

entries.name: Horn of Blasting
entries.description: Blown, a 30-foot Cone: DC 15 Constitution or 5d8 Thunder damage and Deafened for 1 minute. It may explode if used too often.

entries.name: Horn of Valhalla
entries.description: Blown, it calls warrior spirits (Berserkers) that fight for you for 1 hour; their number depends on the horn. Once per week.

entries.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
entries.description: Fixed on a horse, it moves 4 inches above the ground: it crosses any surface, leaves no tracks and never tires.

entries.name: Horseshoes of Speed
entries.description: Fixed on a horse, its Speed increases by 30 feet.

entries.name: Immovable Rod
entries.description: Press its button and it stays fixed in place, holding up to 8,000 pounds, until pressed again.

entries.name: Instant Fortress
entries.description: A statuette that grows into an adamantine tower 20 feet wide and 30 feet high, with a door that opens only for you.

entries.name: Ioun Stone
entries.description: A stone that orbits your head and gives a benefit set by its kind (+1 to AC, +2 to an ability, regeneration, spell absorption…).

entries.name: Iron Bands
entries.description: Thrown, a sphere opens into metal bands: on a hit, the creature is Restrained until it breaks free (DC 20 Strength).

entries.name: Iron Flask
entries.description: Traps a creature from another plane (DC 17 Wisdom), which can later be released to serve you for 1 hour.

entries.name: Javelin of Lightning
entries.description: Its hits can deal Lightning damage; once per dawn, thrown, it becomes a bolt of lightning (4d6 Lightning damage in a line).

entries.name: Lantern of Revealing
entries.description: Its light reveals Invisible creatures and objects within 30 feet.

entries.name: Luck Blade
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage and +1 to saving throws; once per dawn, reroll a failed d20 test, and it may hold a few wishes.

properties.applies_to_keys: glaive, greatsword, longsword, rapier, scimitar, sickle, shortsword

entries.name: Mace of Disruption
entries.description: 2d6 extra Radiant damage against Fiends and Undead, which may be destroyed (DC 15 Wisdom) if left at 25 Hit Points or fewer.

entries.name: Mace of Smiting
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage (+3 against Constructs), and extra damage on a 20, which can destroy a Construct.

entries.name: Mace of Terror
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): a wave of terror Frightens creatures within 30 feet (DC 15 Wisdom).

entries.name: Mantle of Spell Resistance
entries.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells while you wear it.

entries.name: Manual of Bodily Health
entries.description: Study it 48 hours within 6 days: your Constitution increases by 2 (to 30 at most). It then loses its magic for a century.

entries.name: Manual of Gainful Exercise
entries.description: Study it 48 hours within 6 days: your Strength increases by 2 (to 30 at most). It then loses its magic for a century.

entries.name: Manual of Golems
entries.description: Holds what it takes to build one kind of golem, for a spellcaster with two level 5 spell slots, in time and gold.

entries.name: Manual of Quickness of Action
entries.description: Study it 48 hours within 6 days: your Dexterity increases by 2 (to 30 at most). It then loses its magic for a century.

entries.name: Marvelous Pigments
entries.description: 1d4 pots: what you paint with them becomes real (up to 1,000 cubic feet per pot), but nothing worth more than 25 GP.

entries.name: Medallion of Thoughts
entries.description: 5 charges (1d4 back at dawn): 1 charge casts Detect Thoughts (DC 13).

entries.name: Mirror of Life Trapping
entries.description: A creature that sees itself in it may be trapped in one of its twelve cells (DC 15 Charisma) until the mirror frees it or breaks.

entries.name: Mithral Armor
entries.description: Light and flexible: no Disadvantage on Stealth and no Strength requirement.

properties.applies_to_keys: breastplate, chain-mail, chain-shirt, half-plate-armor, plate-armor, ring-mail, scale-mail, splint-armor

entries.name: Mysterious Deck
entries.description: Draw cards at random: each has a powerful effect, good or terrible, from a wish to losing everything.

entries.name: Necklace of Adaptation
entries.description: You breathe normally in any environment, and have Advantage on saves against the Poisoned condition.

entries.name: Necklace of Fireballs
entries.description: 1d6 + 3 beads: throw one up to 60 feet to cast Fireball (DC 15), stronger with several beads at once.

entries.name: Necklace of Prayer Beads
entries.description: 1d4 + 2 magic beads, each casting a spell once per dawn (Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration…). Attunement by a Cleric, Druid or Paladin.

entries.name: Nine Lives Stealer
entries.description: +2 to attack and damage; 1d8 + 1 charges: on a 20 against a creature under 100 Hit Points, it may slay it outright (DC 15 Constitution).

entries.name: Oathbow
entries.description: Name a sworn enemy: Advantage against it, 3d6 extra Piercing damage, and its cover is ignored, until it dies.

entries.name: Oil of Etherealness
entries.description: Applied in 10 minutes, it gives the effect of Etherealness for 1 hour.

entries.name: Oil of Sharpness
entries.description: Coats a nonmagical slashing or piercing weapon or 20 ammunition: it becomes a +3 weapon for 1 hour.

entries.name: Oil of Slipperiness
entries.description: Applied in 10 minutes, it gives the effect of Freedom of Movement for 8 hours; poured, it acts as Grease.

entries.name: Pearl of Power
entries.description: Regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once per dawn. Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Periapt of Health
entries.description: Regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points once per dawn, and Advantage on saves against the Poisoned condition.

entries.name: Periapt of Proof against Poison
entries.description: Immunity to Poison damage and to the Poisoned condition.

entries.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
entries.description: A Death Saving Throw of 9 or lower counts as 10, and your Hit Point Dice heal twice as much.

entries.name: Philter of Love
entries.description: The next creature you see within 10 minutes Charms you for 1 hour.

entries.name: Pipes of Haunting
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): a tune Frightens creatures of your choice within 30 feet (DC 15 Wisdom).

entries.name: Pipes of the Sewers
entries.description: Rats leave you alone; 3 charges to call swarms of rats that you can lead.

entries.name: Plate Armor of Etherealness
entries.description: Gain the effect of Etherealness while you wear it. Once per dawn.

entries.name: Portable Hole
entries.description: A cloth that unfolds into an extradimensional hole 10 feet deep; folded, it holds everything inside.

entries.name: Potion of Animal Friendship
entries.description: Cast Animal Friendship at level 3 (DC 13).

entries.name: Potion of Clairvoyance
entries.description: Gain the effect of Clairvoyance, without Concentration.

entries.name: Potion of Climbing
entries.description: A Climb Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour, and Advantage on Athletics to climb.

entries.name: Potion of Diminution
entries.description: The reduce effect of Enlarge/Reduce for 1d4 hours, without Concentration.

entries.name: Potion of Flying
entries.description: A Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour, and you can hover.

entries.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
entries.description: The effect of Gaseous Form for 1 hour, without Concentration.

entries.name: Potion of Giant Strength
entries.description: Your Strength becomes that of a giant for 1 hour: 21 (hill) to 29 (storm), as its kind says.

entries.name: Potion of Greater Healing
entries.description: Drunk, it restores 4d4 + 4 Hit Points.

entries.name: Potion of Growth
entries.description: The enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce for 10 minutes, without Concentration.

entries.name: Potion of Healing
entries.description: Drunk, it restores 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

entries.name: Potion of Heroism
entries.description: 10 Temporary Hit Points and the effect of Bless for 1 hour, without Concentration.

entries.name: Potion of Invisibility
entries.description: Invisible for 1 hour, until you attack, deal damage or cast a spell.

entries.name: Potion of Invulnerability
entries.description: Resistance to all damage for 1 minute.

entries.name: Potion of Longevity
entries.description: Your physical age drops by 1d6 + 6 years (13 at least); each new potion may age you instead.

entries.name: Potion of Mind Reading
entries.description: The effect of Detect Thoughts (DC 13) for 10 minutes, without Concentration.

entries.name: Potion of Poison
entries.description: Looks like a helpful potion: drunk, 4d6 Poison damage and Poisoned (DC 13 Constitution).

entries.name: Potion of Resistance
entries.description: Resistance to one damage type, chosen by the GM or rolled, for 1 hour.

entries.name: Potion of Speed
entries.description: The effect of Haste for 1 minute, without Concentration nor lethargy at the end.

entries.name: Potion of Superior Healing
entries.description: Drunk, it restores 8d4 + 8 Hit Points.

entries.name: Potion of Supreme Healing
entries.description: Drunk, it restores 10d4 + 20 Hit Points.

entries.name: Potion of Vitality
entries.description: Removes all Exhaustion and the Poisoned condition; for 24 hours, each Hit Point Die heals its maximum.

entries.name: Potion of Water Breathing
entries.description: You breathe underwater for 24 hours.

entries.name: Quarterstaff of the Acrobat
entries.description: +2 to attack and damage; it glows, becomes a 10-foot pole for leaps, or a javelin that comes back, and can deflect attacks.

entries.name: Ring of Animal Influence
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): cast Animal Friendship, Fear on Beasts or Speak with Animals (DC 13).

entries.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
entries.description: Summons a Djinni that serves you for up to 1 hour while you concentrate. Once per dawn.

entries.name: Ring of Elemental Command
entries.description: Linked to one elemental plane: command its elementals, resist its damage, speak its language and cast its spells.

entries.name: Ring of Evasion
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): as a Reaction, turn a failed Dexterity save into a success.

entries.name: Ring of Feather Falling
entries.description: You fall 60 feet per round and take no falling damage.

entries.name: Ring of Free Action
entries.description: Difficult Terrain costs you no extra movement, and magic can't slow you, Paralyze you or Restrain you.

entries.name: Ring of Invisibility
entries.description: As a Magic action, become Invisible until you take it off or choose to be seen.

entries.name: Ring of Jumping
entries.description: Cast Jump on yourself from it.

entries.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
entries.description: Immune to magic that reads your thoughts, lies, alignment or creature type; telepathy only with your leave, and your soul can dwell in it after death.

entries.name: Ring of Protection
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear it.

entries.name: Ring of Regeneration
entries.description: Regain 1d6 Hit Points every 10 minutes, and lost body parts grow back.

entries.name: Ring of Resistance
entries.description: Resistance to one damage type, shown by its gemstone.

entries.name: Ring of Shooting Stars
entries.description: Cast Dancing Lights or Light; 6 charges for Faerie Fire, ball lightning or shooting stars.

entries.name: Ring of Spell Storing
entries.description: Stores up to 5 levels of spells cast into it, which its wearer can cast later.

entries.name: Ring of Spell Turning
entries.description: Advantage on saves against spells; a spell of level 7 or lower you resist has no effect, and may be turned back at its caster.

entries.name: Ring of Swimming
entries.description: A Swim Speed of 40 feet.

entries.name: Ring of Telekinesis
entries.description: Cast Telekinesis from it.

entries.name: Ring of the Ram
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): a ram of force (2d10 Force damage per charge) that can push a creature or break objects.

entries.name: Ring of Three Wishes
entries.description: 3 charges: each casts Wish.

entries.name: Ring of Warmth
entries.description: Cold damage you take is reduced by 2d8, and extreme cold doesn't harm you.

entries.name: Ring of Water Walking
entries.description: Cast Water Walk on yourself.

entries.name: Ring of X-ray Vision
entries.description: As a Magic action, see through solid matter within 30 feet for 1 minute.

entries.name: Robe of Eyes
entries.description: Advantage on sight-based Perception, Darkvision and Truesight of 120 feet, and you can't be surprised.

entries.name: Robe of Scintillating Colors
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): dazzling colors give Disadvantage on attacks against you and can Stun those who see them.

entries.name: Robe of Stars
entries.description: +1 to saving throws; its stars cast Magic Missile, and it can take you to the Astral Plane.

entries.name: Robe of the Archmagi
entries.description: Without armor your AC is 15 + Dexterity, Advantage on saves against spells, and +2 to your spell save DC and spell attack. Attunement by a Sorcerer, Warlock or Wizard.

entries.name: Robe of Useful Items
entries.description: Its patches become the objects or creatures they show when detached.

entries.name: Rod of Absorption
entries.description: As a Reaction, absorb a spell targeting only you and store its energy to cast your own spells.

entries.name: Rod of Alertness
entries.description: Advantage on Perception and Initiative, detection spells, and planted it creates a protective aura once per dawn.

entries.name: Rod of Lordly Might
entries.description: A +3 mace whose buttons turn it into other weapons, a ram, a ladder or a compass, and which can drain life, paralyze or frighten.

entries.name: Rod of Resurrection
entries.description: 5 charges (1 back at dawn): Heal for 1 charge, Resurrection for 5.

entries.name: Rod of Rulership
entries.description: Creatures of your choice within 120 feet are Charmed by you for 8 hours (DC 15 Wisdom). Once per dawn.

entries.name: Rod of Security
entries.description: Takes you and up to 199 willing creatures to a safe demiplane where time heals and feeds them.

entries.name: Rope of Climbing
entries.description: 60 feet of rope holding 3,000 pounds, which moves and knots itself at your command.

entries.name: Rope of Entanglement
entries.description: Its end entangles a creature within 20 feet (DC 15 Dexterity), Restrained until it escapes.

entries.name: Scarab of Protection
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class, Advantage on saves against spells, and 12 charges to resist Necromancy and Undead.

entries.name: Scimitar of Speed
entries.description: +2 to attack and damage, and one attack with it as a Bonus Action each turn.

entries.name: Sending Stones
entries.description: A pair of stones: the bearer of one casts Sending to the bearer of the other, once per dawn.

entries.name: Sentinel Shield
entries.description: Advantage on Initiative and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

entries.name: Shield of Missile Attraction
entries.description: Resistance to ranged weapon damage, but cursed: ranged attacks against creatures near you target you instead.

entries.name: Shield of the Cavalier
entries.description: +2 to Armor Class, a forceful bash that pushes, and a protective field once per dawn.

entries.name: Shield +1
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class, on top of the Shield's own bonus.

entries.name: Shield +2
entries.description: +2 to Armor Class, on top of the Shield's own bonus.

entries.name: Shield +3
entries.description: +3 to Armor Class, on top of the Shield's own bonus.

entries.name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
entries.description: A Climb Speed equal to your Speed, walking on walls and ceilings with free hands (not on slippery surfaces).

entries.name: Sovereign Glue
entries.description: 1d6 + 1 ounces: each bonds two objects permanently, undone only by Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness.

entries.name: Spell Scroll
entries.description: Holds one spell: cast it if it is on your spell list, then the scroll crumbles; a harder spell may need an Arcana check.

entries.name: Spellguard Shield
entries.description: Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and spell attacks against you have Disadvantage.

entries.name: Sphere of Annihilation
entries.description: A 2-foot black sphere that destroys all matter it touches; a creature can try to move it with Arcana checks.

entries.name: Staff of Charming
entries.description: 10 charges: Charm Person, Command or Comprehend Languages, and it can turn back an enchantment cast on you.

entries.name: Staff of Fire
entries.description: Resistance to Fire damage; 10 charges for Burning Hands, Fireball or Wall of Fire.

entries.name: Staff of Frost
entries.description: Resistance to Cold damage; 10 charges for Cone of Cold, Fog Cloud, Ice Storm or Wall of Ice.

entries.name: Staff of Healing
entries.description: 10 charges for Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration or Mass Cure Wounds.

entries.name: Staff of Power
entries.description: A +2 quarterstaff, +2 to AC, saves and spell attacks, and 20 charges for powerful spells; it can be broken in a retributive strike.

entries.name: Staff of Striking
entries.description: A +3 quarterstaff; spend up to 3 charges on a hit for 1d6 extra Force damage each.

entries.name: Staff of Swarming Insects
entries.description: 10 charges: a cloud of insects that Heavily Obscures, or Giant Insect and Insect Plague.

entries.name: Staff of the Magi
entries.description: A +2 quarterstaff, +2 to spell attacks, Advantage against spells, 50 charges for many spells, spell absorption and a retributive strike.

entries.name: Staff of the Python
entries.description: Thrown, it becomes a Giant Constrictor Snake under your control.

entries.name: Staff of the Woodlands
entries.description: A +2 quarterstaff, +2 to spell attacks, 6 charges for nature spells, and it can become a tree.

entries.name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
entries.description: A +2 quarterstaff with lightning, thunder and thunderclap powers, each once per dawn.

entries.name: Staff of Withering
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): on a hit, 2d10 extra Necrotic damage and Disadvantage on Strength and Constitution (DC 15 Constitution).

entries.name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
entries.description: Touched to the ground, it summons an Earth Elemental that obeys you for 1 hour. Once per dawn.

entries.name: Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone)
entries.description: +1 to ability checks and saving throws while it is on you.

entries.name: Sun Blade
entries.description: A hilt from which a blade of radiance springs: +2 to attack and damage, Radiant damage, extra against Undead, and sunlight.

entries.name: Sword of Life Stealing
entries.description: On a 20, 15 extra Necrotic damage, and you gain as many Temporary Hit Points.

properties.applies_to_keys: glaive, greatsword, longsword, rapier, scimitar, shortsword

entries.name: Sword of Sharpness
entries.description: Maximum damage against objects; on a 20, 14 extra Slashing damage and a limb may be cut off; it sheds light on command.

entries.name: Sword of Wounding
entries.description: 2d6 extra Necrotic damage, and the target may be unable to regain Hit Points for 1 hour (DC 15 Constitution).

properties.applies_to_keys: glaive, greatsword, longsword, rapier, scimitar, shortsword

entries.name: Talisman of Pure Good
entries.description: Burns Fiends and Undead who touch it, a holy symbol with +2 to spell attacks, and charges to destroy evil creatures. Attunement by a Cleric or Paladin.

entries.name: Talisman of the Sphere
entries.description: Advantage on Arcana checks to control a Sphere of Annihilation, and you move it farther.

entries.name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
entries.description: Burns creatures that aren't Fiends or Undead who touch it, a holy symbol with +2 to spell attacks, and charges to destroy good creatures.

entries.name: Thunderous Greatclub
entries.description: Your Strength is 20 while attuned; 1d8 extra Thunder damage (3d8 to objects), and thunderclaps and earthquakes once per dawn.

entries.name: Tome of Clear Thought
entries.description: Study it 48 hours within 6 days: your Intelligence increases by 2 (to 30 at most).

entries.name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
entries.description: Study it 48 hours within 6 days: your Charisma increases by 2 (to 30 at most).

entries.name: Tome of Understanding
entries.description: Study it 48 hours within 6 days: your Wisdom increases by 2 (to 30 at most).

entries.name: Trident of Fish Command
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): cast Dominate Beast (DC 15) on a Beast with a Swim Speed.

entries.name: Universal Solvent
entries.description: Dissolves any adhesive, Sovereign Glue included.

entries.name: Vicious Weapon
entries.description: 2d6 extra damage of the weapon's type to any creature it hits.

entries.name: Vorpal Sword
entries.description: +3 to attack and damage, ignores Resistance to Slashing damage, and on a 20 it can cut off a head.

entries.name: Wand of Binding
entries.description: 7 charges: Hold Monster or Hold Person (DC 17), and help escape restraints.

entries.name: Wand of Enemy Detection
entries.description: 7 charges: for 1 minute, the direction of the nearest hostile creature within 60 feet.

entries.name: Wand of Fear
entries.description: 7 charges: Command (flee or grovel) or a cone of fear (DC 15).

entries.name: Wand of Fireballs
entries.description: 7 charges: up to 3 to cast Fireball (DC 15), one level higher per extra charge. Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
entries.description: 7 charges: up to 3 to cast Lightning Bolt (DC 15), one level higher per extra charge. Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of Magic Detection
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): cast Detect Magic.

entries.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
entries.description: 7 charges: up to 3 to cast Magic Missile, one level higher per extra charge.

entries.name: Wand of Paralysis
entries.description: 7 charges: a ray Paralyzes a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (DC 15 Constitution). Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of Polymorph
entries.description: 7 charges: cast Polymorph (DC 15). Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of Secrets
entries.description: 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): points to the nearest secret door or trap within 60 feet.

entries.name: Wand of the War Mage +1
entries.description: +1 to spell attack rolls, and you ignore Half Cover with a spell attack. Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of the War Mage +2
entries.description: +2 to spell attack rolls, and you ignore Half Cover with a spell attack. Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of the War Mage +3
entries.description: +3 to spell attack rolls, and you ignore Half Cover with a spell attack. Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of Web
entries.description: 7 charges: cast Web (DC 13). Attunement by a spellcaster.

entries.name: Wand of Wonder
entries.description: 7 charges: each use produces a random magical effect, from a harmless one to a Fireball.

entries.name: Weapon of Warning
entries.description: You and allies within 30 feet wake when combat begins, have Advantage on Initiative and can't be surprised.

entries.name: Weapon +1
entries.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

entries.name: Weapon +2
entries.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

entries.name: Weapon +3
entries.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

entries.name: Well of Many Worlds
entries.description: A cloth that opens a portal to another world or plane, chosen at random, for a time.

entries.name: Wind Fan
entries.description: Cast Gust of Wind (DC 13); each further use before dawn may tear it.

entries.name: Winged Boots
entries.description: 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour per charge.

entries.name: Wings of Flying
entries.description: Turns into wings: a Fly Speed of 60 feet for 1 hour, then 1d12 hours before it works again.
